yearRationale: The 1957 lightweight works 250F is the best-defined high-performance state: Fangio's championship season, documented 48:52 dry balance, Pirelli stock prepared after the 1956 withdrawal, and a stated 17-inch rear-wheel safety decision. It is not a Dunlop R5 fixture.

taxonomy.reason: Knowledge v1.7.1 adds the supplier-neutral 1954–58 Formula 1 / Grand Prix class CLS102 and maps it to FAM002. It adds no numeric life, pressure, thermal, wear, rate or flex prior. CLS002 remains a 1959-onward FAM003/Dunlop R5 context and is historically wrong for the chosen 1957 Pirelli fixture.
